description.en: Agent OS: the agent gets smarter on its own. We just hold the line: the grading command and expected result never make it into the success contract we hand it. Interview-gated, staged evaluation, budgeted evolution loop. MCP server, 13 runtimes: Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, Copilot,
description.zh: 一个代理操作系统，通过面试门控和预算进化循环让代理自主变得更聪明。

audience.zh: AI代理开发者和自动化爱好者
audience.en: AI agent developers and automation enthusiasts

usecases.zh: 构建自我进化的代理系统，通过分级评估和预算循环实现自动改进
usecases.en: Build self-improving agent systems with staged evaluation and budgeted evolution loops
